storage.title: Cold-Chain Storage & Handling
storage.subtitle: Factual temperature thresholds and handling practices to preserve yield, melt performance, and shelf life.
storage.chefTip1: Never freeze sliced cheddar. Freezing damages moisture emulsion, causing slices to shatter and crumble during sandwich assembly.
storage.chefTip2: Shred mozzarella only when thoroughly chilled (2°C to 4°C). Warm mozzarella gums up commercial shredders and sticks together in bins.
storage.chefTip3: Use dry, sanitized stainless steel utensils in cream cheese tubs. Any introduced water droplets create surface mold risk.
